+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: ffff9280
+title: Drop Linux release targets and llama.cpp leftovers from release config
+---
+Goal: the release config builds macOS Apple Silicon only.
+
+User decision: the Linux targets go. sah is macOS only.
+
+Steps:
+- In `dist-workspace.toml`: remove `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` and `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu` from the targets. Keep the macOS Apple Silicon target. Check for an Intel macOS target and ask the user before you remove it.
+- In `.github/workflows/release.yml`: remove the Linux jobs, matrix legs and runner entries. Remove the llama.cpp out-of-memory comment and any step that exists only for it. Remove the Windows longpaths step if no Windows target remains.
+- If `release.yml` is generated by cargo-dist, change `dist-workspace.toml` first and regenerate the workflow with the project's dist command. Do not hand-edit generated output if a generator exists.
+- Search for other Linux-only references (install scripts, Homebrew formula, docs, `ci.yml` matrix) and fix those that name Linux builds.
+- Do not remove macOS jobs. Do not change publish gates.
+
+Done when: no Linux target remains in `dist-workspace.toml` or `release.yml`, the workflow still parses (`actionlint` if installed, else YAML parse), and the docs agree with the config. #remove-llama-cpp
\ No newline at end of file
